---
listing:
  categories: true
  contents:
  - '*.qmd'
  feed: true
  filter-ui: false
  sort: date desc
  sort-ui: false
  type: default
page-layout: full
title: My Notes
title-block-bannerrR: false
---

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
  const page = document.getElementById("quarto-document-content");
  page.classList.add("clavr-page");

  const cards = document.querySelectorAll(".quarto-post");
  cards.forEach((el) => el.classList.add("notes-card-reveal"));

  const observer = new IntersectionObserver(
    (entries) => {
      entries.forEach((entry) => {
        entry.target.classList.toggle("clavr-in-view", entry.isIntersecting);
      });
    },
    { threshold: 0.2, rootMargin: "0px 0px -80px 0px" }
  );
  cards.forEach((el) => observer.observe(el));

  // Cursor footprint trail. This page's content isn't wrapped in a
  // .clavr-content div (Quarto injects the listing after our markup), so the
  // canvas sits behind everything via a negative z-index inside .clavr-page's
  // isolated stacking context instead.
  const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
  canvas.id = "footprint-canvas";
  canvas.className = "clavr-network";
  canvas.style.zIndex = "-1";
  page.insertBefore(canvas, page.firstChild);

  const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
  let width, height;
  const footprints = [];
  const LIFE_MS = 1700;
  const MIN_STEP = 30;
  let lastX = null;
  let lastY = null;
  let side = 1;

  function resize() {
    width = canvas.width = page.offsetWidth;
    height = canvas.height = page.offsetHeight;
  }
  resize();
  window.addEventListener("resize", resize);
  new ResizeObserver(resize).observe(page);

  function handleMove(e) {
    const rect = page.getBoundingClientRect();
    const x = e.clientX - rect.left;
    const y = e.clientY - rect.top;

    if (lastX === null) {
      lastX = x;
      lastY = y;
      return;
    }

    const dx = x - lastX;
    const dy = y - lastY;
    const dist = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);

    if (dist >= MIN_STEP) {
      const angle = Math.atan2(dy, dx);
      side *= -1;
      footprints.push({ x, y, angle, side, born: performance.now() });
      if (footprints.length > 80) footprints.shift();
      lastX = x;
      lastY = y;
    }
  }

  page.addEventListener("mousemove", handleMove);
  page.addEventListener("mouseleave", () => {
    lastX = null;
    lastY = null;
  });

  function drawFootprint(fp, now) {
    const age = now - fp.born;
    if (age > LIFE_MS) return false;

    const opacity = 0.65 * (1 - age / LIFE_MS);
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(fp.x, fp.y);
    ctx.rotate(fp.angle + Math.PI / 2);
    ctx.translate(fp.side * 6, 0);
    ctx.scale(fp.side, 1);
    ctx.globalAlpha = opacity;
    ctx.fillStyle = "#2c5d85";

    // forefoot pad
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(0, -5, 5.2, 5.8, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // heel pad (gap between the two mimics a shoe-sole print)
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(0, 8.5, 3.4, 4.2, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.restore();
    return true;
  }

  function step() {
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);
    const now = performance.now();
    for (let i = footprints.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      if (!drawFootprint(footprints[i], now)) {
        footprints.splice(i, 1);
      }
    }
    requestAnimationFrame(step);
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(step);
});
</script>
